era: 2019 Pinterest: logged-out visitors saw a grid of Pins behind a white 'Welcome to Pinterest / Find new ideas to try' sign-up card (Email, Create a password, Age, red Continue, OR, Continue with Facebook / Google); signed-in web had a white bar with the red P, a grey rounded search field, Home / Following, and circular icon buttons over a masonry grid. The marketing landing ('Create the life you love', skin-tone, group-board and visual-search modules) is 2021+.
